name: Keyboard Shift
description: Shifts each letter one key to the right.
legacyScript: function animate(env,el,p){ var row1="qwertyuiop",row2="asdfghjkl",row3="zxcvbnm"; function sh(c){ var lo=c.toLowerCase(); var idx=row1.indexOf(lo); if(idx>=0)return row1.charAt((idx+1)%row1.length); idx=row2.indexOf(lo); if(idx>=0)return row2.charAt((idx+1)%row2.length); idx=row3.indexOf(lo); if(idx>=0)return row3.charAt((idx+1)%row3.length); return c; } var t=el.text,o=""; for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++){ var r=sh(t.charAt(i)); o+=(t.charAt(i)===t.charAt(i).toUpperCase())?r.toUpperCase():r; } el.text=o; return el; }
